4.1 Introduction

Soil [माती] is a fundamental resource for food production [उत्पादन] and a crucial asset for farmers. The success of farming [शेती करणे] relies on soil quality [मृदा गुणवत्ता], as it supplies water [पाणी] and vital nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] to crops. When soil [माती] is rich and healthy, combined with adequate water [पाणी] and sunlight, it supports productive farming [शेती करणे] and helps achieve desired yields. Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] treats soil [माती] as a living, multifunctional system [पद्धत/प्रणाली], where soil organic matter [मृदा सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], or humus [ह्युमस], serves as a critical reservoir supporting nutrient [पोषक घटक] retention, water-holding capacity [पाणी धरणक्षमता / पाणी धारण क्षमता], and soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना] (FAO, 2015). Incorporating farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] significantly enhances microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया] and diversity, thereby increasing soil [माती] resilience and nutrient cycling [अन्नद्रव्य चक्र / पोषण चक्र] through the activation of indigenous microbes (Semenov et al., 2021). Long-term use of organic [सेंद्रिय] amendments (e.g., FYM applied at 15 t/ha) markedly increases soil organic carbon [मृदामधील सेंद्रिय कार्बन / मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], dissolved organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन], and key nutrient [पोषक घटक] pools under pearl milletwheat rotations (Sheoran et al., 2025). Soil pH [मातीचा सामू / मृदा सामू], a key determinant of nutrient availability [पोषण मूल्य उपलब्धता], can be effectively managed using natural amendments: lime [चुना] in highly acidic soils-and manure [खत] or straw in moderately acidic soils-not only raise pH by 12-17%, but also improve cation exchange capacity [धनायन विनिमय / कॅटायन विनिमय क्षमता], organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], and crop yield [पीक उत्पादन] (Zhang et al., 2023). A balanced soil [माती] ecosystem, therefore, emerges from the synergy of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] enrichment, microbial vitality, and pH correction, all achieved without synthetic inputs.

Indian Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] experiments have reported measurable improvements in soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] parameters. **Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]:**

**Definition and Concept of Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]:**

The farming [शेती करणे] method in which the use of synthetic fertilizers [रासायनिक खत], pesticides and insecticides [कीटकनाशके], herbicides [तणनाशके], and other chemical components for boosting productivity is completely eliminated, and the living state of the soil [माती] is made the central focus, with the fertility [प्रजननक्षमता], structure, and nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] of the soil [माती] being maintained, and in fact increased, is what is known as organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]. Generally speaking, organic farming methods [सेंद्रिय शेती पद्धती] involve using organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], animal excrement, crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], intercropping [आंतरपीक], green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत], compost [कंपोस्ट] manure [खत] from farm [शेत] waste, vermicompost [गांडूळखत], the use of beneficial bacterial cultures, the use of organic [सेंद्रिय] and natural components for crop protection [पीक संरक्षण], the use of disease [रोग] and pest [कीड]-resistant species [प्रजाती] and seeds, and so on, for permanently maintaining or increasing soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता] and productivity, and these are the major components of organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]. In this farming [शेती करणे] method, the source of the inputs used is also mandatorily organic [सेंद्रिय]. This farming [शेती करणे] method is mutually dependent on all living organisms in the ecosystem.

**Benefits of the Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] Method:**

- The natural and biological fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] of the soil [माती] is maintained.
- Environmental balance is maintained.
- The quality of agricultural production [उत्पादन] is enhanced, and storage [साठवण] capacity is increased.
- The population of friendly insects and beneficial organisms grows rapidly, preventing the infestation of harmful insects.
- The rate of soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] is reduced.
- Livestock [पशुधन] can be used extensively for farming [शेती करणे].
- The water-holding capacity [पाणी धरणक्षमता / पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती] increases.
- Agricultural produce from organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] is free of the toxic residue of insecticide [कीटकनाशक] and fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] substances.

results.question: What is the treatment for Milk Fever in buffaloes?
results.answer:
म्हैसांमध्ये दूध ताप (मिल्क फिव्हर) हा व्यानेनंतर कॅल्शियमची कमतरता यामुळे होणारा चयापचय रोग आहे, आणि उपचार म्हणून शिरेद्वारे कॅल्शियम देणे हे ठरलेले उपाय आहे.

**लक्षणे:**
- व्यानेनंतर साधारण ७२ तासांच्या आत आजारी पडते; हालचालींचा अयोग्य समन्वय, पाय व डोकातील कंप, जमिनीवर झोपणे आणि डोकं बाजूला करणे; शेवटच्या टप्प्यात तापमान कमी होणे, पुपिल वाढणे, मूर्च्छा आणि मृत्यू येऊ शकतो.

**उपचार:**
- शिरेद्वारे ३००–४०० मिली कॅल्शियम बोरोग्लुकोनेट द्रावण देणे, तसेच विटामिन डी३ स्नायूंतून इंजेक्शन देणे.
- लगेच पशुवैद्यकाचा सल्ला घ्या, कारण वेळेत उपचार न केल्यास प्राणघातक होऊ शकते.

**प्रतिबंध/नियंत्रण:**
- गायीसाठी लिटर वरचे चुना पाणी मिसळून देणे याचा उपयोग होऊ शकतो; म्हैसांसाठीही पोषण व कॅल्शियम संतुलनावर पशुवैद्यकाचा मार्गदर्शन घ्या.

The negative effect of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] on milk production [दूध उत्पादन] is due to the decreased nutrient [पोषक घटक] intake and decreased nutrient uptake [अन्नद्रव्य सेवन] by the portal drained viscera of the buffalo [म्हैस]. Blood [रक्त] flow shifted to peripheral tissues for cooling purposes alters nutrient [पोषक घटक] metabolism and contribute to lower milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] during hot weather [वातावरण]. Hormonal alterations also occur with heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] such as plasma [प्लाझ्मा] somatotropin and thyroxine concentration tend to decline with heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण]. Reduced concentrations of these key metabolic hormones with heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] shows the animal attempt to reduce metabolic heat and milk production [दूध उत्पादन]. Heat stressed buffaloes generally exhibit altered blood [रक्त] acid-base chemistry as a result of the shift in cooling from conductive, convective, and radiation to evaporative cooling. Heat-stressed animals have elevated rectal temperature [तापमान] and respiratory rate accompanied with a diurnal variation [दिवसातील तापमान बदल] in blood [रक्त] pH and blood [रक्त] bicarbonate levels. Their acid-base chemistry exhibits wide swings from alkalosis to a compensated acidosis resulting in a metabolic acidosis during the cooler evening hours. Reduced concentrations of blood [रक्त] bicarbonate compromise the buffering capability associated with the bicarbonate system [पद्धत/प्रणाली], which may be critical during summer. During hot seasons the dry matter [सुका घटक] intake of buffaloes is decreased moreover the ratio [प्रमाण] of forage [चारा] to concentrates [दाणेदार खाद्य] intake is also decreased. In other words, the decline in milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] at higher temperature [तापमान] is more marked in buffaloes that produce more milk [दूध]. Effect of thermal stress [तापमान ताण] on camel production [उत्पादन] traits

Heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] significantly affects milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] and composition in dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] animals. Although most research has concentrated on cattle [गाय वर्ग], the impact of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] on dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] camels has received less attention. Camels are noted for their ability to maintain milk production [दूध उत्पादन] during drought [दुष्काळ] conditions due to unique physiological adaptations that support continued milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] under prolonged inclement conditions. They produce more milk [दूध] for longer periods compared to other arid-adapted domestic animals, which is crucial for pastoral and agro-pastoral communities. However, prolonged drought [दुष्काळ] can eventually lead to decreased milk production [दुधाचे उत्पादन कमी होणे] under thermal stress [तापमान ताण] conditions. Studies indicate that high ambient temperatures and severe water [पाणी] deprivation reduce camel milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] and fat content [चरबी प्रमाण], with reductions generally proportional to the degree of dehydration [निर्जलीकरण]. Seasonal changes also significantly influence camel milk [दूध] composition, with variations in total solids [एकूण घनपदार्थ] and other milk [दूध] components linked to heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण], feed [खाद्य/चारा] quality, and water [पाणी] availability. Camel milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] peaks within a specific temperature [तापमान]-humidity [आर्द्रता] index (THI) range. During dry [कोरडे] and hot seasons, increased diurnal body temperature [शरीराचा तापमान] and high THI values suggest that local weather [वातावरण] conditions, including temperature [तापमान] and relative humidity [सापेक्ष आर्द्रता], significantly impact camel thermoregulation. In contrast, the wet season [हंगाम/ऋतू] is associated with higher concentrations of milk [दूध] protein [प्रथिने], casein, total solids [एकूण घनपदार्थ], solidnot-fat, and lactose, likely due to better forage [चारा] quality. Specifically, milk [दूध] fat is significantly lower in summer, while protein [प्रथिने] and lactose levels peak in February and are minimal in October and September, respectively. Thus, fat and protein [प्रथिने] concentration in camel milk [दूध] decreases significantly during dry [कोरडे], hot periods, highlighting the effects of seasonal and environmental variables on milk [दूध] composition. Additionally, variations in milk [दूध] composition across locations are attributed to differences in management [व्यवस्थापन] practices and the quality and quantity of available feed [खाद्य/चारा] which are the indirect repercussions of thermal stress [तापमान ताण].

```
MILK [दूध] FEVER [ताप]

Milk [दूध] fever [ताप], also known as hypocalcemia or parturient paresis, is a metabolic disorder that commonly affects dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] cows during the early stages of lactation. It occurs due to a sudden drop in blood [रक्त] calcium [कॅल्शियम] levels, which can lead to muscle weakness [अशक्तपणा / दुर्बलता] or paralysis. Milk [दूध] fever [ताप] is primarily caused by an imbalance between the calcium [कॅल्शियम] demands of the cow [गाय] during early lactation and its ability to mobilize calcium [कॅल्शियम] from its body reserves or absorb calcium [कॅल्शियम] from its diet. Highproducing dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] cows experience a sudden increase in calcium [कॅल्शियम] requirements at the onset of lactation, as they need to produce and secrete large amounts of milk [दूध]. If the cow [गाय]'s dietary calcium [कॅल्शियम] intake is insufficient to meet these demands, it can lead to hypocalcemia. The treatment [उपचार] of milk [दूध] fever [ताप] involves raising the blood [रक्त] calcium [कॅल्शियम] levels in the affected cow [गाय]. This is typically achieved through the administration of intravenous calcium [कॅल्शियम] solutions, such as calcium [कॅल्शियम] gluconate or calcium [कॅल्शियम] borogluconate. Veterinary assistance is required to administer these treatments effectively. In severe cases, additional supportive therapy [सहायक उपचार], such as fluid therapy and antiinflammatory drugs, may be necessary.

Specific Nutritional Strategies could be as below -

1. Dietary management [व्यवस्थापन]: Balancing the prepartum diet to provide adequate, but not excessive, calcium [कॅल्शियम] and controlling the dietary cation-anion balance (DCAB) can help

results.answer:
जास्त वाढ व मोठे वजन या दृष्टीने शेळीच्या जातींपैकी **जामुनापारी** ही जात सर्वाधिक उंच आणि भारी मानली जाते, तसेच महाराष्ट्रातील **उस्मानाबादी** ही जातही लवकर वाढून एक अर्धा वर्षांत ४० ते ५० कि.ग्रा. पर्यंत पोहोचू शकते.

**जातींची माहिती:**
- **जामुनापारी:** नर ६० ते ९० कि.ग्रा., मादी ५० ते ६० कि.ग्रा. इतके वजन असतात; ही जात दूध व मांस दोन्हीसाठी चांगली आहे.
- **उस्मानाबादी:** कोरड्या हवामानात चांगली वाढ होते; शुद्ध वंशाचे शेळी एका अर्ध्या वर्षांत ४० ते ५० कि.ग्रा. पर्यंत पोहोचू शकतात; जमिनीवर चरायला सोयीची व रोगप्रतिकारशक्ती चांगली असलेली जात आहे.
- **कोकण कांयल (कोकणासाठी):** पूर्ण वाढ झालेल्या नराचे सरासरी वजन ५० कि.ग्रा. आणि मादीचे ३२ कि.ग्रा. इतके नोंदले आहेत; मांस उत्पादनासाठी निवडलेली जात आहे.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला; महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ, राहुरी; डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५**

- शेडमध्ये जितके शक्य तितका थेट सूर्यप्रकाश पडेल अशी व्यवस्था करा; सूर्यप्रकाश हा जीवाणूनाशक म्हणून सुरक्षित आणि स्वस्त पर्याय आहे.

**डिसइन्फेक्शन (रोग उद्रेक असल्यास):**
- सर्व फ्लोर, १.५ मीटर उंचीपर्यंत भिंत, पाण्याच्या तळांचे आतील भाग, चार्याचे तळ आणि प्राण्यांच्या संपर्कात येणारे साहित्य डिसइन्फेक्ट करा.

**आहार संतुलन:**
- कुक्कुट खाद्य घटक प्रामुख्याने कार्बोहायड्रेट (ऊर्जा), प्रथिने, चरबी, पूरक व अॅडिटिव्ह या गटांत विभागले जातात.

- जमिनीची मशागत वेगाने व सपाट होते, त्यामुळे पेरणी/लागवडीसाठी तयारी लवकर होते.

results.answer:
जीवामृताचा वापर केल्याने पिकांना पोषक तत्वे पुरेशी मिळतात, मातीतील उपयुक्त जीवाणूंची संख्या वाढते आणि पीक वाढीला चालना मिळते; त्यामुळे उत्पादन खर्च कमी होतो व उत्पन्न वाढण्यास मदत होते.

**फायदे:**
- पिकांना पोषक तत्वे पुरेशी प्रमाणात उपलब्ध होतात.
- मातीमध्ये उपयुक्त जीवाणूंची संख्या वाढते.
- पीक वाढीला चालना (वाढ प्रोत्साहन) मिळते.
- घरच्या शेण व घरी बनवलेल्या हरभरा पीठाचा वापर झाल्याने उत्पादन खर्च कमी होतो आणि उत्पन्न वाढते.

**इतर फायदे (सेंद्रिय/नैसर्गिक शेतीत):**
- सेंद्रिय खतांचे विघटन वेगाने होऊन मातीची सुपीकता वाढते.
- मातीतील गांडूळांची संख्या वाढते.
- कीड व रोगांचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होण्यास मदत होते.
- सिंचनाची वेळ कमी लागते आणि लाभ-खर्च गुणोत्तर चांगले राहते.

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला; नीती आयोग (नैसर्गिक शेती मार्गदर्शक)**

The method of using organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], green manures, bacterial fertilizers, and organic [सेंद्रिय] liquids in appropriate proportions as complementary fertilizers along with chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] is called Integrated Nutrient Management [समन्वित अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मीक पोषक व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन].

In this method, a balance is maintained between chemical, organic [सेंद्रिय], and biological fertilizers [जैविक खत]. Also, by including leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] in crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता] is maintained. By saving expensive chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], soil productivity [मृदा उत्पादकता] is continuously improved year after year. In this method, generally half of the total requirement of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] is supplied through chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], and the remaining half is supplied through organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]. 4.Potassium [पालाश]:

Potassium [पालाश] is the third most abundant mineral in the animal body and serves as the primary intracellular ion, with concentrations ranging from 100 to 160 mmol/L in body tissues. It plays a crucial role in maintaining nerve and muscle excitability, as well as regulating the body's water balance [जल संतुलन] and acid-base equilibrium. Potassium [पालाश] is also involved in cellular respiration [श्वसन] through the chloride shift and influences various intracellular processes, including enzyme function and muscle contraction.

For herbivores, potassium [पालाश] deficiency is uncommon, as most forages naturally contain adequate levels of this mineral. However, when deficiency does occur, it can lead to symptoms [लक्षणे] such as muscle weakness [अशक्तपणा / दुर्बलता], stiffness, paralysis, and intracellular acidosis. In potassium [पालाश]-deficient animals, the reduction of potassium [पालाश] in milk [दूध] is more pronounced than in plasma [प्लाझ्मा]. Dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] calves with marginal potassium [पालाश] deficiency may show decreased appetite [भूक] and reduced weight gain [वजन वाढ], even when plasma [प्लाझ्मा] potassium [पालाश] levels appear normal.

5.Sulphur [गंधक]:

The identification of methionine, an essential amino acid containing one sulphur [गंधक] atom per molecule, highlighted the importance of sulphur [गंधक] as a dietary nutrient [पोषक घटक]. Sulphur [गंधक] is found in connective tissues as sulphate and is a component of the natural anticoagulant [रक्त गोठणे प्रतिबंधक द्रव्य] heparin [हेपारिन]. It is also present in important hormones such as insulin and oxytocin, as well as in vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] like thiamine and biotin. Sulphur [गंधक] is abundant in keratin-rich structures including hooves [खुर], horns, feathers, wool fibre, and mohair. The rumen [रुमेन]'s microbial flora can incorporate inorganic sulphur [गंधक] into microbial proteins, which then serve as a high-quality amino acid source for the animal.

Symptoms [लक्षणे] of sulphur deficiency [गंधकाची कमतरता / गंधक कमतरता] include slowed growth [वाढ], excessive shedding of wool or hair, profuse salivation, excessive tearing, and in severe cases, emaciation leading to death.

Copper [तांबे] plays a crucial role in animal biology through its involvement in several copper [तांबे]-dependent enzymes. Copper [तांबे] is a rate-limiting element in the production [उत्पादन] of ceruloplasmin (ferroxidase), an enzyme necessary for oxidizing iron [लोह], which allows iron [लोह] to bind to its transport protein [प्रथिने], transferrin. Additionally, copper [तांबे] is vital for the proper functioning of the immune system [पद्धत/प्रणाली], supporting the activity of T and B lymphocytes [लिम्फोसाइट्स], neutrophils [न्युट्रोफिल्स], macrophages, and the complement system [पद्धत/प्रणाली], thereby highlighting its important role in the body's immune response (Sharma et al., 2001b).

The most consistent clinical sign of copper deficiency [तांब्याचा अभाव] in cattle [गाय वर्ग] is abnormal hair pigmentation, characterized by a change in coat color known as achromotrichia. This discoloration is especially noticeable around the eyesreferred to as "spectacling"as well

as on the ear tips and flanks. Additional neurological symptoms [लक्षणे] include an inability to suckle, lack of coordination, a stiff gait, and opisthotonos.

Copper deficiency [तांब्याचा अभाव] also affects connective tissues, leading to improper bone development and an increased susceptibility to long bone fractures. Treatment [उपचार]

Depending on the extent of the disease [रोग] condition, intravenous isotonic 1.3-1.4 % solution of sodium bicarbonate solution is given as treatment [उपचार].

Alkalosis

Elevated blood [रक्त] pH is the hallmark of alkalemia, also known as metabolic alkalosis, which is often driven on by excessive acid loss, increased absorption of alkali, or a carbon dioxide deficiency.

Etiology [रोगकारण]

Metabolic alkalosis commonly arises from condition like abomasal atony, which may occur due to abomasal impaction. Under these events, potassium [पालाश] and hydrochloric acid are continuously secreted into the abomasum, resulting in hyperchloremic and hypokalaemia alkalosis. Furthermore, metabolic alkalosis can cause a shift in potassium [पालाश] from extracellular to intracellular locations, which may exacerbate hypokalaemia even in cases where the body potassium [पालाश] levels are acceptable.

Clinical signs

Animal alkalosis may be challenging to diagnose due to a lack of specific clinical symptoms [लक्षणे]. It frequently causes convulsions, tetany, tremors in the muscles, and shallow respirations. In more severe phases, dyspnoea and hyperpnea can appear.

Treating alkalosis in animals involves fluid therapy with 0.9% isotonic saline along with electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] management [व्यवस्थापन], including giving potassium [पालाश] chloride (KCl) at 20-40 mEq/L IV, are crucial.

Definition and causes

Net losses from gastrointestinal diseases account for most animal electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] abnormalities. Definition and Etiology [रोगकारण]

The deficiency of vitamin A in young animals is manifested as the compression of brain and spinal cord whereas in adult animals the syndrome is characterized by night blindness, corneal keratinization, pityriasis, defects in the hooves [खुर], loss of weight, and infertility [वंध्यत्व]. Congenital defects are common in the offspring of deficient dams. There are two types of vitamin A deficiencies, (i) primary diseases, which result from an absolute lack of the vitamin A or its precursor carotene in the diet; (ii) secondary diseases, which occur when there is an adequate dietary supply of the vitamin A or its precursor but problems with digestion, absorption, or metabolism cause its deficiency at tissue level. **मातीत मिसळून:**
- कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ मातीमध्ये २५० कि.ग्रा प्रति हेक्टर प्रमाणात मिसळा, जेणेकरून मातीची सुपीकता आणि पोषणधारणा सुधारते.

**रासायनिक खतासोबत:**
- यूरिया खत कडुलिंबाच्या पेंडासोबत ५:१ या प्रमाणात वापरा (म्हणजे ५ भाग यूरिया : १ भाग कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ).
- ऊसासाठी यूरियात कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ १:६ या प्रमाणात वापरण्याची शिफारस आहे.

- बुरशीनाशके (जैविक) वापरताना ती सेंद्रिय खते, पेंड आणि शेणखत यांसोबत मिसळून ओल्या मातीत १५–२० दिवस आधी टाका; मात्र ट्रायकोडर्माच्या वाढीसाठी उंदी/करंज/एरंडेल पेंड कडुलिंबाच्या पेंडाऐवजी फायदेशीर असतात.

## **Care of Betel Vine**

Betel vine is a cash crop [नगदी पीक] in Vidarbha and betel vine orchards are mostly found in Akola, Amravati, Buldhana, and Yavatmal districts. The following integrated disease management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] package is recommended for the management [व्यवस्थापन] of wilt disease [मररोग] of the Kapoori variety of betel vine and for better growth [वाढ] of the vines [वेली]:

**Integrated Disease Management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] Package**

**Package - 1:**

a) **Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] (Seed Treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] + Soil [माती] Application [वापर/फवारणी]):**

1. Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] with 09 liters of water [पाणी] and dip the seedlings in this solution before planting.
2. Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] powder with 09 kg of well-decomposed manure [खत] and apply 100 grams of this mixture per square meter to the soil [माती] near the roots of the vines [वेली] at monthly intervals (from June to January).

b) **Neem Cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ]:** Apply 20 quintals of neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] per hectare in the soil [माती], divided into two applications in June and December.

c) **Salicylic Acid:** Spray 10 ppm salicylic acid on the vines [वेली] twice a year (in June and December).

d) **Chemical Fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:** Apply Nitrogen [नत्र], Phosphorus [स्फुरद], and Potash in the ratio [प्रमाण] of 100:50:50. (Apply Phosphorus [स्फुरद] and Potash together initially in June, while Nitrogen [नत्र] should be applied in the form of ammonium sulphate in two divided doses (in June and December)).

e) **Irrigation Management [सिंचन व्यवस्थापन]:** Use drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] for irrigation management [सिंचन व्यवस्थापन].

**Package - 2:**

a) Mix 10 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] harzianum in 20 quintals/ha of Neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] and apply it in June and December in two parts.

b) Mix 5 tons each of manure [खत] and alluvial soil [माती] plus 2 tons of goat [शेळी] manure [खत] plus 10 kg of phosphorus [स्फुरद] dissolving bacteria [जीवाणू] per hectare and apply it collectively in July.

**Benefits of Fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे]:**

- In the fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] method, labor, machinery, fuel, electricity, water [पाणी], and fertilizers are saved.
- Appropriate nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] can be given in a specific amount at the right time as per the requirement of the crop [पीक].
- Water [पाणी]-soluble liquid fertilizers are mostly acidic and have a low salt [मीठ] load, are sodium and chlorine-free, so the soil [माती]'s water [पाणी] and fertilizer [खत] are used efficiently, the soil [माती]'s fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] is maintained, and there is a good increase in production [उत्पादन].
- Water [पाणी]-soluble fertilizers are given only in the active area of the crops through drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन], so they are absorbed efficiently.
- Crops grow vigorously, are not susceptible to diseases, and the expenditure on fungicides [बुरशीनाशके] is reduced.
- Fertilizers can be given according to the growth [वाढ] of the crop [पीक], which increases the efficiency of fertilizers and increases production [उत्पादन].
- Fertilizers can be given by dividing them according to the soil [माती], crop [पीक], and weather [वातावरण] changes.
- Water [पाणी]-soluble fertilizers can be given through drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] or by spraying [फवारणी].

The use of water [पाणी]-soluble fertilizers from the water [पाणी] given through fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] can also be used for spraying [फवारणी]. It is necessary for this level of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] in the leaves to be sufficient for proper production [उत्पादन]. For this, it is very important to get these nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] in a balanced amount according to the needs of different stages of crop [पीक] growth [वाढ]. results.question: भातातील Gall Midge कसा ओळखावा आणि त्याचे नियंत्रण कसे करावे?
results.answer:
भातातील गॅल माइडज (गादमाशी) ही गुलाबी रंगाची, माश्यासारखी दिसणारी कीड असून तिच्या अळीमुळे भाताच्या रोपावर पांढऱ्या-पिवळसर रंगाचा कांद्यासारखा नळिका तयार होतो; याला “ट्यूब” किंवा “पोंग” म्हणतात.

**ओळख:**
- कीड गुलाबी रंगाची आणि माश्यासारखी दिसते; अळी अंकुरात शिरून तो खाते.
- अळीच्या ठिकाणी अंकुर फुगून पांढरा-पिवळसर कांद्यासारखा नळिका तयार होतो; संक्रमित रोपांची वाढ खुंटते व टिलरिंग कमी होते.

**प्रतिबंध:**
- गादमाशी प्रतिकारक वाण लावा (उदा. सिंदेवाही-२००१, साकोली-८, पी.के.व्ही. गणेश).
- गादमाशी जास्त येणाऱ्या भागात २ ते २० जुलै या कालावधीत लागवड शिफारस केलेल्या दिनांपेक्षा १५ दिवस लवकर करा.
- चिखलणीच्या वेळी शेतात गरडी पाने १.५० टन/हे. टाका.
- आजूबाजूची सहाय्यक तृणधान्ये (देोधन) नष्ट करा.
- कीडग्रस्त रोपे उपटून नष्ट करा.

**रासायनिक नियंत्रण:**
- गादमाशी प्रवण भागात रोपवाटिकेत ५% चांदीचे शूट आढळताच, पुनर्लागवडीनंतर १० व ३० दिवसांनी उंचावर ७ ते १० से.मी. पाणी असताना कार्बोफ्युरान ३% २५ कि.ग्रा./हे. किंवा क्विनॉल्फॉस ५% ५ कि.ग्रा./हे. दाणेदार फवारणी करा; हे पाणी चार दिवस बाहेर घेऊ नका.
- फवारणीसाठी लॅम्ब्डा सायहॅलोथ्रिन २.५% द्रव ५०० मि.ली., प्रेफोनिल ५% द्रव १००० मि.ली., किंवा थायमेथॉक्सॅम २५% डब्ल्यू.एस. ५०० ग्राम प्रति ५०० लिटर पाणी वापरण्याची शिफारस आहे.

**स्रोत: डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला**

आपल्या भागात लागवड कोणत्या तारखेला केली होती आणि सध्या रोपवाटिका आहे की मुख्य शेती?

```
**Use of Pheromone Traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] for Pest Management [कीड व्यवस्थापन]**

**Insects release a mixture of chemicals with a specific odor from their bodies to communicate with members of their own species [प्रजाती]. These chemicals create a specific reaction in them and perform the function of communication, and are called pheromones. Currently, artificially produced pheromones of some insects are available in the market for sale.**

**Pheromones are widely used to find efficient mates for mating. Insects of the opposite sex are attracted to each other for mating by its smell. We can use it for the following reasons.**

1. **To monitor pests through traps [सापळे].**
2. **To destroy the pests by catching moths in large numbers in the trap.**
3. **To prevent reproduction by creating obstacles in the mating of insects.**

**Pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] are mainly used to initiate pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] operations in various crops. For monitoring [निरीक्षण/देखरेख], 5 traps [सापळे] are sufficient in one hectare of area. A number is fixed as to how many moths should be trapped in the trap to start crop protection [पीक संरक्षण] measures. For example, if an average of 8 to 10 moths of pod borer [शेंगा पोखरणारी अळी] are found continuously for 2-3 days in each trap, then it is necessary to immediately implement pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] measures.**

**Pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] can be used to catch moths when the number of pests is very low. For this, 10 to 12 pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] are installed in one hectare of area and moths are caught in large numbers, which helps in reducing further reproduction. To create obstacles in the mating of insects, the subtle odor of sex pheromone [फेरोमोन] chemical spreads in the atmosphere through the trap. Due to this, the insects are deceived while searching for a mate for mating. As a result, there is no reproduction because they do not mate. Therefore, a decrease in the number of insects in the next generation is observed. Currently, pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] for pod borer [शेंगा पोखरणारी अळी], Spodoptera larva on soybean [सोयाबीन], larvae on eggplant, okra [भेंडी], cabbage [कोबी / पत्ता कोबी], sugarcane [ऊस], cotton [कापूस], and fruit fly [फळमाशी] are available in the market. Their price is Rs. 50 to 125 per trap. Pheromones are changed every 2 to 3 weeks. Their price is Rs. 10 to 50 per lure [आमिष].**
